correctness.rationale: The final repaired RESULT.md retains the finite principal-ideal-ring theorem and corrects the earlier blanket assertion about equivalence to the cozero-divisor complement for all finite rings. That assertion fails for F₂[x,y]/(x,y)²: the classes of x and y share annihilator (x,y) but generate incomparable ideals. In the actual theorem's chain factors a uniformizer gives ann(level j)=m^(length−j) and weights (q−1)q^(length−j−1), with top weight one. The whole-ring componentwise comparable ordered count is T, equal-profile ordered count Q. Remove UP+P−U pairs and U²+1 equal-profile pairs; internal edges were counted twice and loops once. This gives exactly E as stated. Incomparables have a common neighbor exactly when the meet survives deletion of bottom or the join survives deletion of top. Otherwise they are opposite Boolean corners. The stated three-edge support path for r≥3 and interior-level path for r=2 with a non-field factor exist; two field factors instead leave exactly two disconnected cliques. Complementary corner classes have size-product U, proving D3 and the disconnected count, and subtracting from all unordered pairs gives D2 and the Wiener formulas. The r=1 case is complete when nonempty, with zero polynomial for fewer than two vertices. My direct multiplication replay for (Z/4)² obtains 11 vertices, pair counts (30,21,4) and W=84, and explicitly checks a two-field case, a three-field case and an empty field graph. The proof, not those tests, supplies the general quantifier.
residual_risks: No theorem about distances for nonprincipal finite rings or infinite rings. Disconnected pairs are excluded from any finite Wiener index. The empty zero-ring convention is stated separately.

value.rationale: The result resolves all shortest-path pair counts uniformly, gives a structural characterization of the farthest pairs, and explains exactly the exceptional disconnected boundary. It sharpens the relevant bound in a natural broad ring class and corrects an actual example about a small ring under its unchanged graph definition; it is not justified merely by adding a verifier. Restricting the complement equivalence to the legitimate class preserves this entire useful contribution.
residual_risks: No reconstruction of the ring from the Wiener polynomial or generalization beyond local chain factors is claimed.
